summary: This video examines top-ranking Temporal Vortex IV teams from the Chinese server ahead of Season 9 launch. The meta showcases Dauntless teams leading the leaderboards at 60B to 68B damage, with alternative viable archetypes including Ice Blast (40B-45B), Aura (42B), and new Corrosion comps (39B). Neff highlights key build differences on the Chinese server, including building Kurvida with Skill Haste rather than Attack Speed, and running Child of Chaos with the Puppeteer set at Inspiration 5. Detailed gear setups emphasize stacking 8% team damage boosting mythic gear up to 3 times and sharing attack stats across key DPS heroes.

teams.note: Top-ranking Dauntless Lightning comp hitting up to 68B damage; paired with Poison supports like Child of Chaos, Serpentemis, Sleight, Twitch, and Sacredeia.
Fire/Lightning affinity Dauntless alternative hitting over 61B damage, ideal for players lacking Maashtur.

Corrosion lineup achieving around 39B damage using Rhyviel as a primary DPS.

meta_changes: Dauntless remains dominant in Vortex with scores approaching 70B, but Ice Blast (40B-45B), Aura (42B), and Corrosion (39B) are proven viable options on advanced servers.
Dragonflame 8% team damage boosting mythic armor stacks up to 3 times across separate friendly heroes for a maximum 24% damage boost.
Realm of the Fallen gear rotates out in upcoming seasonal transitions, requiring players to plan mythic gear exchanges.
tips: When building Child of Chaos with the Puppeteer set, ensure 48 to 55 Skill Haste and select healing/accuracy talents rather than resistance-ignoring talents.
Stack the 8% team damage dragon armor piece across up to three heroes to gain a cumulative 24% total team damage increase.
Consider testing Skill Haste builds on Kurvida rather than pure Attack Speed to ensure maximum uptime on Defense Down and team utility.
